build_task_template: build a phyre task template with a ball that must pass through a hole in the ground
create_bar_with_hole: create left and right static bars with a configurable gap between them using _bar_with_hole
define_task_with_decorator: define a parameterized task template using the define_task_template decorator with ball_size, hole_size, hole_left, and bar_height
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid task parameter combinations by raising SkipTemplateParams when the ball is bigger than the hole
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by setting body1, body2, and TOUCHING spatial relationship via update_task
